name: Draft social media posts and captions
description: Users asked the assistant to draft various short-to-medium length posts, captions, and notes for diverse social media platforms, such as Instagram, Telegram, Twitter, and Facebook. The requests covered a wide range of topics, including event announcements, personal stories, motivational quotes, and promotional content, often with specific requests for tone, formatting, hashtags, or emojis.
